raw_extraction.description: Interact programmatically with your Vercel account using the SDK or direct HTTP requests. Vercel provides a REST API with endpoints for managing access groups, AI gateway configurations, artifacts, billing, bulk redirects, checks, networking, connectors, deployments, DNS records, and more, enabling frontend teams to do their best work with a focus on end-user performance.
raw_extraction.api_breadth: The API covers a wide range of functionality including access groups, AI gateway configurations, artifacts cache management, billing charges and commitments, bulk redirects management, checks and check runs, networking including secure compute networks and PrivateLink endpoints, connectors management, deployments management, and DNS records management.
raw_extraction.buildability_rationale: The official Vercel REST API documentation provides extensive REST endpoints for managing various resources programmatically, indicating that building integrations is feasible. Authentication method is indicated as 'other' since the exact method is not explicitly stated in the retrieved evidence, but the API is accessible for self-serve paid users. The breadth of the API is broad, covering many aspects of Vercel's platform.
